area: Assessment checks: ZIA governance and audit (zscaler_full_checks GOV.1-GOV.8, zscaler_rbac_checks RBAC.13-RBAC.14), their reads in the sample tenant and snapshots, and the subscriptions that make a check N/A
title: Zscaler's configuration audit, alert subscriptions, NSS VM health and log streaming, admin password expiry and Zscaler Support access: read-only, in scope only, N/A when not licensed, recipients counted, verified offline against the SDK 1.11.3 models

checks.what: Every new read verified against zscaler-sdk-python 1.11.3: system_audit.get_config_audit (/configAudit), admin_roles.get_password_expiry_settings (/passwordExpiry/settings), remote_assistance.get_remote_assistance (/remoteAssistance), alert_subscriptions.list_alert_subscriptions (/alertSubscriptions), nss_servers.list_nss_servers (/nssServers), nss_collectors.list_collectors (/nssCollectors), organization_information.get_subscriptions (/subscriptions); the sample's answers use only the models' field names
Scope: GOV.* run only with ZIA platform and RBAC.13-14 only with RBAC; the snapshot plan reads the new endpoints only for those keys
N/A: the NSS checks are 'not licensed' (outside the score) only when the subscriptions were read and hold no NSS SKU; unreadable or unparsable subscriptions never mark N/A
Privacy: alert recipients are counted, never listed, on the checks and through a snapshot round trip; no admin name appears
Untrusted text: Zscaler's recommended-configuration strings lose control characters and are capped before they enter a finding
A config audit refused for lack of the Reports scope (403) is 'Not permitted', never judged
Snapshot: the admin password expiry switch survives the scrubber as true/false and a number; text under those names and real password fields stay masked
Read-only: no new write path; every read is a GET through the existing clients

findings.title: A snapshot masked the admin password expiry switch and its days as if they were passwords; the masked '(not set)' is a truthy string, so a password expiry check on a snapshot of a tenant with expiry off would read it as on
findings.fix: offline_tenant.scrub keeps passwordExpirationEnabled and passwordExpiryDays only as a bool or an int (text stays masked); RBAC.13 accepts only a real true/false

findings.title: The governance checks first parsed the subscriptions with readiness.parse_subscriptions; readiness decodes unverified token claims and must stay out of every module but the server
findings.fix: zscaler_full_checks._subscriptions parses the SKU ids itself (bounded, id pattern, expired or unsubscribed rows are not active); no import of readiness

findings.title: The new-marks browser tour hard-coded items of the 2026-10-28 release (the Test a list tab, #paProto, marks on the POV, Simple and Operations pages), so listing any newer release in static/whats_new.js broke a dozen browser assertions
findings.fix: tests/test_new_marks.py takes the oldest marked release from the manifest, probes * then ? on the home page's Path analyzer button, rotates with a far-future release and asks for a mark at 320px only on pages that still have one

findings.title: readiness.py said the ZIA /subscriptions endpoint is not in the SDK; zscaler-sdk-python 1.11.3 has organization_information.get_subscriptions (only the row shape is assumed)
findings.fix: readiness.py docstring and SUBSCRIPTIONS_PATH comment corrected

findings.title: The Scope page and its help said ZIA platform runs 33 checks while the registry had 37 (45 with the governance checks)
findings.fix: static/index.html and static/help_catalog.js (and the extension copy) give 45 and 14 (RBAC)

findings.title: tests/test_new_marks.py::test_no_sideways_scroll_at_320px[/report/advanced] and tests/test_flow_pages.py::test_no_motion_page_scrolls_sideways[320-walk-normal|reduce] fail on a clean origin/dev checkout (1b2420b) in this environment: content sits past the right edge at 320px
findings.reason: Not caused by this change (it fails identically before it) and outside the governance package; left for the UI owners
